tools.name: macaroons_search
tools.description: Search Macaroon Network for capabilities matching an intent. Returns ranked listings with price, predicate hash, and freshness. Free, no payment required.

intent.description: Natural language description of what the agent needs. E.g. 'source-labelled Christian scripture evidence'

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

category.description: Optional canonical category id from macaroons_categories.

tools.name: macaroons_metadata
tools.description: Get free metadata for a feed target before purchasing. Returns freshness and content_hash. No payment required.

tools.name: macaroons_categories
tools.description: List Macaroon's canonical intelligence categories and exact mapped product counts. Free, no payment required.

tools.name: macaroons_discover_mcp
tools.description: List evidenced live Macaroon MCP servers and transports. Free.

tools.name: macaroons_sources
tools.description: List reviewed source records, rights states, provenance requirements, and honest mapping coverage. Free.

tools.name: macaroons_execute
tools.description: Execute a paid marketplace capability by capability_id using x402 USDC on Base. Payment only settles if the acceptance predicate passes against the bridge response; bridge errors and predicate failures refund. If no wallet is configured (the default), returns x402_payment_required with the real payment terms for you to pay/sign yourself.

input.description: Capability input payload matching the listing input_schema.

predicate.description: Optional acceptance predicate. Defaults to the listing's sample_predicate when omitted.

payment_signature.description: Only set this after a prior call returned x402_payment_required and you've since signed the exact-scheme USDC payment it described with your own wallet — set it to the resulting signed proof. Omit on a first attempt.
